summary: Innventure, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $60,000,000 of common stock under a Sales Agreement with Lucid Capital Markets, LLC dated October 6, 2026. Shares trade on Nasdaq under INV, last reported at $0.504 on October 2, 2026. Agent compensation is 3.0% on the first $15M and 2.17% on the next $45M of gross sales. No escrow, minimum purchase, or specific share count is required. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and overhang risk.
